errorCodes.meaning: No member with the supplied `did` exists.
`role` was `admin`. Promotion to admin is a separate, gated flow, not a metadata update.

The update would set `publishConsent` to true for a member who has not consented. Registry consent is the member's own decision, given on their join request; an update may withdraw it, never grant it. Nothing in the request was applied.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

MemberResponse.description: One community member as the maintainer sees it: the membership record joined with its ACL role.

currentRoleVacId.description: Id of the member's current role credential — a community-issued Verifiable Authority Credential conferring `role:<name>` — if issued. Formerly `currentRoleVecId`.

currentVmcId.description: Id of the member's current Verifiable Membership Credential, if issued.

departurePreference.description: How the member's record is handled on departure.

extensions.description: Opaque community-defined extension bag. Keys are maintainer-defined; the maintainer caps its size (16 KiB in the reference implementation).

joinedViaInvitation.description: Whether this member joined by presenting an invitation credential rather than by an admin's decision on an open request. The two routes to membership carry different evidence, and an operator reviewing a roster can otherwise not tell them apart.

memberVmcId.description: `id` of the member-issued reciprocal membership credential — the member half of the pair — once the member has sent it. Absent until then, which is the useful signal: it distinguishes a membership the community has asserted from one the member has acknowledged. The credential body is not echoed here.

memberVmcReceivedAt.description: When that reciprocal credential was received. Paired with `memberVmcId`.

personhood.description: Whether the community has asserted that this member is a distinct real person. Read-only here: it is set and cleared by the personhood verbs, and cleared by a renewal-policy downgrade. Load-bearing rather than informational — a community that recognises members of another community may gate on it, so a consumer that cannot read it cannot make that decision.

personhoodAssertedAt.description: When personhood was most recently asserted. Absent where it never has been. Operator-facing: it belongs on admin-gated reads, and a member's own view of themselves need carry only the flag.

publishConsent.description: Whether the member consented to being published in the community directory.

role.description: The member's role in wire form (e.g. `admin`, `moderator`, `custom:editor`).

statusListIndex.description: The member's slot on the community's membership status list, when allocated.

MemberResponse.title: MemberResponse

extensions.description: Replacement extension bag (maintainer-capped, 16 KiB in the reference implementation).

label.description: Operator-facing display label for this member. Editable, unlike the DID it labels — which is the point: an operator needs a name they can read on a roster of identifiers they cannot. `null` clears it; omit to leave it unchanged.

publishConsent.description: New directory-publish consent. May only withdraw consent (`true` → `false`) or restate the current value; `true` for a member whose record does not already carry it is refused with `consentGrantForbidden`. Consent is the member's own, given by `registryConsent` on `vtc/join-requests/submit`.

role.description: New role (wire form). MUST NOT be `admin` — promotion to admin is a separate, gated flow, not a metadata patch.
